$comment: What the string scanner (scripts/i18n/lib/scan.cjs, docs/design/output-and-languages.md section 16.1) may find without it being UI text, each with its reason. 'files' are left out whole, 'texts' are patterns over a finding's text (optionally only for some kinds), 'sites' are one file's findings by kind and exact text, or by a 'pattern' over the text. Font stacks, ids, ffmpeg arguments, CSS values, test ids and log lines are not scanned at all (they reach no sink); AI prompts in src/main/ai/* go to a service, not to a sink. Add an entry only with its reason; a UI text never belongs here.
